details.geometry: below the crown, two rows of 14 planar 'dragon-scale' facets each, phase-aligned with the crown wedges, each row steeper than the one above: row 1 (red) ≈50° from r≈0.89 to ≈0.96 cap, row 2 (blue) ≈72° from r≈0.96 to 1.0 cap (v20: user 22:51 wants the two scale rows taller / the edge band thicker); below row 2 a short vertical 14-gon side runs down to the dark seam. The side therefore reads as a 14-gon, not a turned cylinder | v18 (user 2026-09-07 18:33): the ≈0.057 R 'vertical side' under the skirt is NOT part of the cap: the cap rim (disc + crown + skirt) OVERHANGS a recessed rotating hub / bearing seat of smaller radius ('黄色的部分，它的圆圈的半径应该是大于内部的这个轴心的转动的承托的…绿色的应该是往内收…上下内凹的这个圆盘要稍微盖住中间的一点点'). The cap underside is a flat lip from the skirt bottom inward to the hub; the hub seat cylinder (radius ≈ cap − 0.03 R provisional, height ≈0.057 R) connects cap and rotor; the dark seam is the shadow gap under the overhang. Top and bottom caps mirror this. | v21 (user 2026-09-08 13:21 '这个不是一体的，叶片是分开转的'): the hub under the cap is NOT part of the rotor. It is a static hub core (bearing housing, r ≈0.41 R provisional) running from cap to cap through a through-bore in the rotor (r ≈0.425 R); the rotor is a separate part that spins around it with a visible radial clearance ring. The rotor ring connecting the three blades under the cap must stay ≥ 0.06 R wide (structural), which fixes the maximum bore; hence the cap overhangs the hub by ≈0.075 R (more than the 0.03 R of v18/v20).

details.name: blade top: a few large hard-cut planar facets, convex lower envelope (叶顶大平面硬切)
details.geometry: the blade top is the LOWER ENVELOPE of a few large planes (the body is what remains after each plane cuts away material), not a mesa with skirts (v15) and not a tent of crest lines (v9-v14). User 2026-09-07 13:27 drew the facets on f0132 (2.4x crop, NCC 0.92 at frame (287,396)): green = the stem crease above the pocket apex continuing as the pocket's right rim; blue quad = one large tip facet from the stem to the edge band; red = straight creases between planes, meeting at a junction K outside the pocket corner; second blue = the root-corner facet at the edge. Per half-blade three planes: T (tip facet: contains the stem crease along the axis, falls toward the tip and outward), F (pocket-flank facet: its upper edge IS the pocket rim, horizontal at the crest height, falls outward), C (root-corner facet: from the pocket corner and K down to the root edge). Creases: T∩T' = stem (on the axis, from the pocket apex to the tip, falling), T∩F from the pocket apex to K, F∩C from the pocket corner to K, T∩C from K to the edge band; all straight, hard. The surface is convex (min of planes) so it has no valley anywhere (user 11:47). Heights provisional.

Provisional layout from the crest to the mid-plane: top facets T/F/C (≈15°) -> tier A: large staggered planar quads ≈0.07 R wide at ≈22° (≈0.25 R long, offset half a facet from the kites) -> kite facets (≈38°, light) interlocking with Λ facets (≈53°, dark) reaching the mid-plane, one deep zigzag between them (v15 reading of f0148/f0150/f0152 at 10x kept).
